description:
The /tree overlay renders as a narrow panel widget squeezed between status bar columns rather than a full-width dialog that replaces the main content area.

## Upstream behavior

Upstream renders a full-width takeover:
- Tree completely replaces the main content area (chat messages hidden)
- Bordered top and bottom with `─── Session Tree ───` dashed lines
- Full terminal width used for the tree list

## Current behavior

Our /tree renders in the lower-right panel with the chat content still visible above it. The tree is constrained to a narrow column because the renderer mounts it as a panel widget (via `focus(%{state | tree_selector: ts}, {:dialog, :tree_selector})`) rather than as a full-screen overlay.

## Where to fix

`apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex`:
- The dialog render path for `:tree_selector` needs to render the tree at full terminal width/height, hiding the main content area
- Likely needs a dedicated render branch in the renderer that gives the tree the full screen dimensions

## Verification

Open /tree and confirm chat messages are no longer visible; tree fills the full terminal width.
title: /tree overlay: full-width dialog takeover instead of panel widget
